name: Aftercare

description.content: You and up to [3] Survivors see each other's Auras whenever:

items: You unhook them, or they unhook you.
You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.

description.content: This effect lasts until you are hooked.

quote: "Oil work to honor my best buddies. the best musicians I know. Their album got me through dark times." -Jeff, oil on canvas, 16x16
